children: was cut to neutral from overweight at Piper Sandler due to agentic AI and private equity investment in the pest control space.

Agentic AI search appears to favor small/local pest control providers over national companies, Piper Sandler analyst Peter Keith wrote in a note late on Wednesday. In addition, increased private equity investment in the space is creating a more competitive backdrop for Rollins

"With the previously cited concerns, we are no longer confident ROL has a clean path back to its targeted organic growth rate of 7%-8%," Keith, who cut his price target on Rollins to $33 from $46, wrote. "As a result, we believe stock price (and valuation) will remain range-bound and we are unable to recommend ROL shares."
